Encore pendant — assembly

drag = rotate · wheel/pinch = zoom · slider = open/close

two snap-fit shells · XIAO ESP32-S3 (no camera, pins clipped) + LiPo 502030

orange sheet = copper tape — the touch electrode, glued inside the recess behind the pulse (1.0 mm wall under the engraving); yellow wire → GPIO1 (T1). Tap the pulse = pin.

black sheet = 2.4 GHz FPC WiFi antenna — glued under the front ceiling, upper band: away from the copper (detuning), the mic chamber and the battery. Thin coax loops to the U.FL socket on the board.

battery → XIAO soldering (shells hidden)
1 · cut the JST-PHR-02 off, trim leads to ~20 mm, strip 2 mm, tin them
2 · flip the XIAO: the two BAT pads (gold) are on the underside near the USB end
3 · tin both pads, then solder red → BAT+ and black → BAT− (the shiny blobs) — polarity is critical
4 · leads run in the foam-tape layer between battery and board (the routed path shown)
5 · charging then works through the USB-C slot — the XIAO's charge IC does the rest
6 · touch: copper tape (orange) glued behind the engraved pulse inside the front shell, yellow lead soldered to GPIO1 (T1) top-side through-hole — the pulse relief becomes the pin button (double tap = pin, long press = privacy)
7 · antenna: click the U.FL plug flat onto the board BEFORE placing it in the case (press straight down until it clicks, never at an angle), dab of hot glue on the plug, stick the FPC sheet under the front ceiling (upper band), coax in a loose loop — no tension when closing, ≥5 mm from the copper tape
